question: LCM and HCF of two numbers are 144 and 8 respectively. If one of the numbers is 16, then find the other number.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Direct formula: Other Number = (LCM × HCF) ÷ Given Number

⇒ Other Number = (144 × 8) ÷ 16

⇒ Other Number = 144 ÷ 2 = 72

**∴ The correct answer is 72.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

LCM of the two numbers = 144

HCF of the two numbers = 8

One of the numbers (N1) = 16
